title: Grateful Dead Live at Lakeland Civic Center on 1982-09-12
lineage: Cassette Master (Sony TC-K677ES) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) ->Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Pristine, reverb‑rich soundboard recording captures a high‑energy 1982 show with standout Not Fade Away, Morning Dew and The Wheel.
ai_review.review: The three five‑star reviews rave about the exceptionally clear, punchy sound—thanks to Frank Streeter’s front‑of‑house Sennheiser setup that adds a unique heavy reverb while remaining crisp. Musically the show is praised for its powerful second set, memorable Not Fade Away closing, an inspiring Wheel entrance and excellent Morning Dew performance, making it a fan favorite despite the unknown exact date.

ai_rating.rationale: All three detailed reviews are uniformly five‑star, highlighting both an outstanding recording and a strong performance; limited to three reviews gives medium confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑house Sennheiser mics provide pristine clarity with a heavy, natural reverb that remains punchy and upfront; no dropouts or muffiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong second set highlighted by an exciting Not Fade Away closer and a well‑executed transition into The Wheel; overall flow praised.
